definitions.full: H1894. hobni [ הָבְנִי ] noun [masculine] ebony (so Symm ᵑ9 Ki & moderns; otherwise ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ; Egyptian heben , Lieblein ÄZ 1886, 13 compare Pinsk Einleitung 83 ; Greek ἔβενος , Latin hebenum ) — only plural הָבְנִים Ezek 27:15 Qr (Kt הובנים ) והבנים שֵׁן קַרְנוֺת ; it was brought from India, & (finer) from Ethiopia, compare Sm & references
definitions.rootNote: only in plural, from an unused root meaning to be hard;
